周天沉的目光在鱼吞舟和守心道长之间来回打转，眉头拧成了一道深沟。
这位上清法脉的大人物，难不成动了收徒之心？
那鱼吞舟与李小先生间的辈分，也该是师侄师叔才对……代师收徒？不，这绝无可能……
那就是这位故意为之，让李景玄喊鱼吞舟为师兄，日后再收后者为弟子，凭空砍落李景玄的辈分？
也不对，岂会如此无聊……可这位真的不会如此无聊吗？
周天沉只觉脑子根本不够用，左右脑博弈，一个念头冒出，就被另一个念头推翻，最后一片浆糊。
根本猜不透这位道长的半分心思。
他已入道胎，铸就了道心，在同境中也不算弱手，但面对这位，仍旧像个面对老天爷的稚童，怎么猜都是错。
自古天意高难问，莫过于眼前人。
“咦，小周啊，你怎么还没走？”
老道长疑惑望去，“难不成老道还要留你在观中用斋饭？”
周天沉猛然回过神，先是看了眼仍徘徊在鱼吞舟身边的清风，又看了眼李景玄。
前者毫无随他一同回去的意思。
李景玄道：“周先生，我会先在道观暂居一段时日，梳理道场气数之事，还请容我过几日再前往。”
周天沉看了眼道长，这次道长没有反对，他点头道：
“没有问题。”
说罢，周天沉不舍地看了眼鱼吞舟的肩头，再次郑重补充道：
“这【天鹏负青图】的修行上如果有什么问题，随时可以来道场找我。”
等这少年来了祖宅，祖灵应当就会自动归家了……

待周天沉下山离去。
鱼吞舟也告辞，准备晚饭去了。
道观之中。
檀香袅袅，烛火摇曳，将道长与李景玄的影子拉得很长，映在斑驳的墙壁上。
李景玄无奈道：“师兄似乎很看好鱼师兄，但让他和我扯上关系，未必是好事。”
在他看来，这位师兄此次的布局，实在太过孩子气，就好像一时兴起，硬要恶心他一回，结果一计不成，最后又让他对着一个出身乡野，根脚平平的少年俯首，口称师兄。
这些他其实都不在乎。
大道在前，这些都只是旁枝末节。
只是鱼吞舟和他扯上关系，真不是什么好事，若是哪天因他而死，那就是罪过了。
“你要住下也可以，睡哪。”
守心道长指向一旁的书屋，随后嗤笑道，“让你喊他一声师兄，确实有给他增添一份福缘的想法，但你焉知这不是你的缘法？”
李景玄神色瞬间严肃起来：“鱼师兄身上，难道还藏了什么秘密？”
“秘密？没什么秘密，出身乡野，父母早亡，根脚平平，一切都干干净净，不然早被三十九家生吞活咽了。”
李景玄默然片刻，问道：“这三年来，鱼师兄是如何入了师兄眼中的？让师兄都忍不住为他挣一份缘法？”
不谈修为境界，这位师兄的眼界之高广，上清法脉难有人出其左右。
而鱼师兄这样出身的少年，不该落其眼中，更不该让他这般费心费力地为其铺陈缘法。
老道长摇头道：“他什么也没做，和我们的一切往来，都守着他那些天经地义的道理。
硬要说他做了什么，那就是做好了自己。”
李景玄轻轻点头，是了，如果只是一味讨好，这位师兄反而不会多看这位鱼师兄一眼。
倒是这般环境，还能坚守本心，看来他新认的这位鱼师兄，也是位难得的妙人。

老道长看向道观外的夜色，负手而立，轻叹道：“人生在世，何必处处讨好他人，先做好自己，讨好自己吧。”
李景玄思索片刻：“等师兄离去，我可以照看鱼师兄一二，为其调解来自各家的敌意，确保他日后可以活着离开此方洞天。”
老道长微笑道：“这是驻守圣人该做的事吗？规矩呢？”
李景玄淡然道：“我的大道在哪，规矩就在哪。”
老道长必须承认，如果李景玄真的代表天鹏道场参与这场道争，那对此次三十九家弟子而言，都将是一场灭顶之灾。

Zhou Tianchen's eyes flickered back and forth between Yu Tunzhou and Taoist Shouxin, his brows furrowed into a deep groove.
Is it possible that this important person with the highest dharma lineage wants to recruit a disciple?
Then the seniority between Yu Tunzhou and Mr. Li Xiao should be that of nephew and master...accepting a disciple on behalf of a master? No, this is absolutely impossible...
Is this this person who deliberately made Li Jingxuan call Yu Tunzhou his senior brother, and then accept the latter as his disciple in the future, thus cutting off Li Jingxuan's seniority out of thin air?
That's not right, how could it be so boring... But is this person really not so boring?
Zhou Tianchen felt that his brain was not full at all. The left and right brains were playing games. One thought came up and was overturned by another, and he ended up in a blur.
It's impossible to guess the half-hearted thoughts of this Taoist priest.
He has entered the womb of Taoism and has forged a Taoist heart. He is not a weak hand in the same situation, but facing this person, he is still like a child facing God. No matter what he guesses, he will be wrong.
Since ancient times, the most difficult question to ask about God’s will is the person in front of you.
"Hey, Xiao Zhou, why haven't you left yet?"
The old Taoist priest looked at him in confusion, "Is it possible that the old Taoist still wants to keep you in the temple to eat fast?"
Zhou Tianchen suddenly came back to his senses. He first glanced at Qingfeng, who was still lingering next to Yu Tunzhou, and then at Li Jingxuan.
The former has no intention of going back with him.
Li Jingxuan said: "Mr. Zhou, I will stay in the Taoist temple for a while to sort out the aura of the Taoist temple. Please allow me to go there in a few days."
Zhou Tianchen glanced at the Taoist Priest. This time the Taoist Priest did not object. He nodded and said:
"No problem."
After saying that, Zhou Tianchen glanced at Yu Tunzhou's shoulder with reluctance, and solemnly added again:
"If you have any questions about the practice of [Tianpeng Negative Blue Picture], you can come to the dojo to see me at any time."
When this young man comes to the ancestral home, the ancestral spirit should return home automatically...
Wait until Zhou Tian sinks down the mountain and leaves.
Yu Tunzhou also said goodbye and went to prepare dinner.
In the Taoist temple.
The scent of sandalwood and the flickering candlelight stretched the shadows of the Taoist Priest and Li Jingxuan onto the mottled walls.
Li Jingxuan said helplessly: "Senior Brother seems to be very optimistic about Senior Brother Yu, but it may not be a good thing for him to have a relationship with me."
In his opinion, this senior brother's plan this time was too childish, as if he was trying to disgust him on a whim, but the plan failed. In the end, he was made to bow to a young man from the countryside with mediocre feet and call him senior brother.
He actually doesn't care about any of this.
The road lies ahead, these are just side effects.
It's just that it's not a good thing that Yu Tunzhou has anything to do with him. If he dies because of him one day, it will be a sin.
"You can stay here if you want. Sleep somewhere."
Taoist Master Shouxin pointed to the bookstore on the side, and then sneered, "If you call him senior brother, you do have the idea of ​​adding a blessing to him, but how do you know that this is not your destiny?"
Li Jingxuan's expression suddenly became serious: "Is there any secret hidden in Senior Brother Yu?"
"Secret? There is no secret. I was born in a rural area, my parents died young, I have a mediocre foundation, everything is clean, otherwise I would have been swallowed alive by the Thirty-Nine Family."
Li Jingxuan was silent for a moment and asked: "How did Senior Brother Yu fall into the eyes of Senior Brother Yu in the past three years? So that Senior Brother could not help but earn a fortune for him?"
Regardless of the realm of cultivation, this senior brother's vision is so broad that it is difficult for anyone in the Shangqing Dharma lineage to surpass him.
And a young man with Senior Brother Yu's background should not fall into his eyes, let alone let him work so hard to lay out a fate for him.
The old Taoist priest shook his head and said: "He didn't do anything, and all his dealings with us were based on his principles.
If you insist on saying what he did, it was to do a good job for himself. "
Li Jingxuan nodded lightly, yes, if he just wanted to please, this senior brother would not give this senior brother Yu a second look.
But in such an environment, he can still stick to his heart. It seems that the new Senior Brother Yu he met is also a rare and wonderful person.
The old Taoist priest looked towards TaoLooking at the night outside, he stood with his hands behind his hands and sighed softly: "In life, why bother to please others everywhere? Just be yourself first and please yourself."
Li Jingxuan thought for a moment: "When senior brother leaves, I can take care of senior brother Yu, mediate the hostility from various families, and ensure that he can leave this cave alive in the future."
The old Taoist priest smiled and said: "Is this what the garrison saint should do? What are the rules?"
Li Jingxuan said calmly: "Where my path is, there are the rules."
The old Taoist priest must admit that if Li Jingxuan really participates in this Taoist dispute on behalf of Tianpeng Taoist Temple, it will be a disaster for the thirty-nine disciples this time.
